purpose: Stable, name-independent identity for political actors across sources and time, solved before any bulk ingestion.

entity_kinds.party: A registered political party or movement (legal entity in the national register, where one exists). ID pp-<cc>-<NNNN>.
entity_kinds.electoral_contestant: What appears on one ballot: a party's own list, a joint list, an electoral alliance/coalition, an electoral committee, a leader-named list, a minority list. Election-specific. ID ct-<cc>-<NNNN>.
entity_kinds.parliamentary_group: A group (klub, Fraktion, poslanecký klub) in one legislature. ID pg-<cc>-<NNNN>.
entity_kinds.ep_national_party: The EP's per-term national party code (e.g. HU12 in 2024-2029, EP Open Data org/NNN). Mapped via the crosswalk, never an Atlas entity of its own.
entity_kinds.ep_political_group: European Parliament political group (EP org identifier). ID epg-<id>.

linked_tables.names: party_names: canonical (native official), English (official or source-provided, marked), abbreviation, aliases, transliterations — each dated and sourced
linked_tables.contestants: contestant_members (which ballots the party ran under)
linked_tables.source_ids: party_identity_crosswalk (ČSÚ VSTRANA, EP party IDs, ParlGov party_id, CHES party_id, Manifesto party code, national register numbers)
linked_tables.evidence: every relation and crosswalk row cites a source document

party_record.display_rule: Display the name valid at the record's date in the record's language; never relabel history with the current name.

relation_types.meaning: Same legal entity, new official name.
relation_types.evidence_required: registry entry or official party/registry announcement

relation_types.meaning: New legal entity designated as legal successor of another.
Entity A ceased and joined entity B (B continues).
Entities A and B ceased and formed new entity C.
Entity B was founded by members leaving A; A continues.
relation_types.identity_effect: new atlas_party_id for B; no continuity with A
relation_types.evidence_required: documented founding; not inferred from shared politicians

relation_types.meaning: Party ran within a joint list/alliance in one election.
Party's MPs sat in a parliamentary group.
Sources disagree whether two entities are the same.
relation_types.identity_effect: two IDs kept; relation status 'disputed' with both sources cited

never_infer: continuity from similar or identical names
continuity from shared leaders or MPs
that an electoral alliance, joint list or committee is a party
that a parliamentary group is a party
that a merged list's votes belong to one member party
a party family, ideology or EU stance from coalition participation, EP group or news reporting
vote_attribution_rules: Votes and vote shares belong to the contestant that appeared on the ballot (party list or joint list), never split across member parties.
Seats may be attributed to member parties only where the official or EP source does so (e.g. EP seats-breakdown-parties), recorded with that source.
Party-level time series across elections are only shown where the contestant was the party's own list in each election; otherwise the series breaks and the joint-list contestant is shown.

crosswalk_match_basis.official_code: Source code issued by the authority and stable across elections (e.g. ČSÚ VSTRANA).
crosswalk_match_basis.manual_review: Reviewer decision with written note; status provisional until second review.
crosswalk_match_basis.forbidden: string similarity, fuzzy matching or translation equivalence as sole basis

worked_cases_from_audit.case: Czech list 'ČSSD – Česká suverenita sociální demokracie' (ČSÚ VSTRANA 759, verified_live in ps2025 vysledky.xml) in 2025 vs the historical ČSSD, renamed SOCDEM in 2023 (background_to_verify)
worked_cases_from_audit.handling: Do not link by name. Resolve VSTRANA continuity and the 2023 rename from the ČSÚ party register and the Ministry of the Interior register; until then status 'unmatched'.

worked_cases_from_audit.case: EP 2024: HU01 'Fidesz-KDNP' (COALITION, votes 44.82%) with seats on HU12 (10) and HU13 (1)
worked_cases_from_audit.handling: HU01 → electoral_contestant (joint list) with members pp-hu-NNNN (Fidesz) and pp-hu-NNNN (KDNP) — opaque IDs, names only for illustration; votes on the contestant; seats on member parties per EP source.

worked_cases_from_audit.case: EP 2024: 'Die Linke' coded as COALITION with two member IDs (DE24|DE23)
worked_cases_from_audit.handling: Record as published; flag for manual review; do not merge or split automatically.
Two parties; one Bundestag parliamentary group; national result rows remain per party as published by the Bundeswahlleiterin.

worked_cases_from_audit.case: Poland: electoral committees (e.g. KO, Trzecia Droga, Lewica) vs member parties
worked_cases_from_audit.handling: Committees are contestants; member parties via contestant_members from PKW registration documents.

worked_cases_from_audit.case: Serbia: leader-named lists (list names change every election)
worked_cases_from_audit.handling: Each list is a contestant; lead party via source-documented list registration; no cross-election continuity without evidence.

worked_cases_from_audit.case: EP per-term party IDs (HU01 in 2004 ≠ HU01 in 2024)
worked_cases_from_audit.handling: Crosswalk keyed by (source, term, party ID).

review_workflow: 1. Load source party lists into a staging crosswalk with match_status 'unmatched'.
2. Auto-confirm only on official_code or registry_number agreement.
3. Everything else goes to a review queue with the evidence documents.
4. Disputed cases keep two IDs and a 'disputed_continuity' relation.
5. A validator rejects any crosswalk row whose match_basis is missing or forbidden.
